description: This file is a React-Redux container component for the FileAttachmentList component, managing state mapping and dispatching actions related to file attachments in Mattermost.

methods.name: makeMapStateToProps
methods.description: Creates a function to map Redux state to component props, selecting files based on post type and metadata.

methods.name: mapStateToProps
methods.description: Maps specific parts of the Redux state to component props, including file info, count, and UI flags.

methods.name: mapDispatchToProps
methods.description: Binds action creators to dispatch for use in the component.
